entries.title: Choose a task key when you add a project
entries.body: Settings → Projects has a Task key field where you add a project. The next project you add numbers its tasks with those letters, such as INF-1, instead of letters taken from its name. When Firstmate asks to add a project, it can name a key too, and its card shows it. A key another project already has is refused, and nothing is added.

picture.alt: Firstmate's card asking to add infinitary from GitHub names its task key, INF, beside where the project comes from
